ideas.pitch: An AI-powered crop yield and soil health forecasting platform that integrates localized weather data with multi-spectral drone imagery to predict micro-farming anomalies.
ideas.title: AgriYield-AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns directly with the Agriculture domain challenge at SUAS Indore, combining hard machine learning models with a clear localized impact on farming.

ideas.pitch: A clinical decision support dashboard that predicts patient readmission risks using tabular hospital records and provides local explanations via SHAP.
ideas.title: MediReadmit-Explain
ideas.why_it_could_win: Healthcare is a core focus area for the Datathon, and judges prioritize interpretable ML models that can be immediately understood by medical professionals.

ideas.pitch: An IoT and CCTV telemetry log analysis system that detects traffic bottlenecks and anomalous congestion patterns in real-time.
ideas.title: SmartCity-TrafficAnomaly
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets the Smart Cities domain explicitly and features a working anomaly detection pipeline similar to successful operational intelligence hacks.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered satellite monitoring tool to track environmental degradation and industrial deforestation over designated green belts.
ideas.title: EcoAudit-Satellite
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves an Environment domain problem using geospatial data analysis, matching the winning formula of satellite monitoring systems.

ideas.pitch: An automated evaluation tool for educational admission and grading datasets that detects, explains, and mitigates algorithmic bias.
ideas.title: EduFair-BiasAudit
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines the Education domain with fairness and transparency metrics, satisfying the core data science interpretation criteria of the judges.
